title: Rosemary Beach: Casa de Mercado in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Casa de Mercado in Rosemary Beach. Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Luxury Mercado Retreat in the Heart of Rosemary Beach

Experience elevated coastal living in this newly remodeled residence, ideally positioned in the coveted Mercado building of Rosemary Beach. Thoughtfully designed for both sophistication and comfort, this stunning retreat blends modern finishes with timeless style — creating the perfect balance between luxury and livability for families and friends alike.

Inside, the spacious layout offers two king suites, a queen bedroom with twin bunks, a bonus bunk room, and a child-sized alcove perfect for a little one or an afternoon nap. Every detail has been curated for beauty and function, ensuring everyone has their own inviting space to relax and unwind.

Both king suites feature private en suite bathrooms — the primary suite showcasing a soaking tub, walk-in shower with bench seating, and double vanities, while the guest king bath impresses with a beautifully tiled shower accented in soft green hues. The queen bedroom and bonus bunk room share a stylish hall bath with double vanities and a walk-in shower, ideal for families traveling together.

The open-concept living area exudes warmth and elegance with designer furnishings, natural light, and a private balcony offering Gulf glimpses and a bird’s-eye view of Rosemary Beach. The dining space features a large table with bench seating, perfect for family dinners or lively game nights, while the new coffee nook invites slow mornings with your favorite brew.

Step out onto the primary suite’s private balcony, complete with a bistro table and chairs overlooking scenic 30A — an ideal spot to enjoy a quiet sunrise or evening glass of wine.

Beautifully updated, meticulously maintained, and centrally located just a short stroll from the beach, boutique shops, fine dining, and all four community pools, this luxury Mercado retreat captures the essence of refined coastal living — where modern design meets family comfort in the heart of Rosemary Beach.

*THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS, SATURDAY-SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER*
